“ Oh gosh! I'm late for class! Wait... I'm on vacation! „

Sunset Vacation (Korean: 선셋 바캉스, seonset bakangseu) is Latte Cookie's first Costume, released in the Summer Party at Marine Soda Bay! update. It is a Super Epic Costume that can be obtained either by drawing it from the Costume Gacha or by purchasing it in the Rainbow Crystal Shop.

Story

Latte Cookie is finally on vacation. No lectures to rush to, no schedules to keep...! Just the open beach and the quiet joy of taking it slow. As the warm orange glow of the sunset paints the fading sky gently, she wonders if every day could feel just like this one.

Trivia

  • Sunset Vacation was released alongside  Sunset Goggles,  Stepping into the Summer Sun, and Seaside POP! Star.
  • Sunset Vacation is a Costume that originates from Cookie Run: OvenSmash's Sunset Vacation.
